items.question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?
items.referenceAnswer: 20 working days per year, increasing to 25 after 5 years of service.

items.question: How many unused vacation days can I carry over and until when?
items.referenceAnswer: Up to 5 days, which must be used before March 31.

items.question: What is the minimum password length?
How quickly must I report a lost laptop or phishing email?
Can I paste customer contracts into ChatGPT?
items.referenceAnswer: No. Confidential data must never be pasted into public AI tools; use DocuMind.

items.question: What is the hotel limit per night in London?
items.referenceAnswer: 250 EUR per night for US / UK.

items.question: When do I need VP approval for flights?
What service credit does an Enterprise customer get if uptime is 98.5%?
Which regions can Enterprise customers store data in?
items.referenceAnswer: EU (Frankfurt) by default, plus US (Virginia) or Turkey (Istanbul).

items.question: Yurt dışından yılda kaç gün çalışabilirim?
What equipment and allowances do remote workers get?
items.referenceAnswer: Handbook: 600 EUR home office stipend and 30 EUR monthly internet. Turkey: laptop, monitor, headset, 750 TL internet, 5,000 TL chair.
